specimen_handling: Author Table S2 Patient labels matched exactly to all23 GEO samples;separate tissues;no suffix-based pairing
library_handling: No independent library identifier supplied;retain author orig.ident/sample labels
threshold_rationale: Coverage-only decision, before reading target expression. At 20 cells worst-case binomial standard error for detection is approximately 0.112 even under cell independence; threshold only flags coarse descriptive support, not precision or biological independence. At least five donors permits an exploratory donor distribution; not a power claim. All smaller groups and all zero target values remain visible separately.
primary_summary: Qualified-patient descriptive median and IQR; fewer than five qualified patients flagged LIMITED_COVERAGE; display all-covered sensitivity separately
detection: Number of cells with raw target UMI > 0 divided by number of cells in patient/type stratum
pseudobulk: Sum raw target UMI and all measured gene UMI within patient/type; CPM=1e6*target_sum/all_gene_sum, no pseudocount, no imputation, no log transform
zero_handling: Retain measured target zero; absent cell type is not a zero-expression patient; nonpositive library size is NOT_EVALUABLE
cross_lineage_composition: NOT_RUN;author compartment export omits7163 GEO cells;no whole-tissue proportions
normal_tumor: Separate descriptive strata; no differential tests or paired effect inference
gene_annotation: Prefer exact source symbol. Only HGNC-confirmed ADSS2 previous symbol ADSS allowed. Missing/ambiguous genes retained NOT_EVALUABLE, never zero and never substituted by paralogs.
family: NA: descriptive localization only, no P values or BH correction
limitations: Author compartment export is a subset of GEO cells
No separate mast-cell annotation in compartment exports
Epithelial annotation alone does not establish malignancy
Expression does not establish metabolite source or metabolic flux
Independent biological origin established at study/recruitment description level;no cross-study patient ID linkage
privacy: Expression summary suppressed for fewer than 3 patients; coverage retained
target_scope: All35 already functionally reviewed genes, user-directed expansion; not entire458-gene planned pool
reuse: Methods and targets only; new cohort numeric summaries
enrichment: DAPI viable singlet sorting;no CD45 selection described
identity_rule: Exact author cell IDs;explicit sample/patient correspondence;no positional joins
source_gene_policy: Complete measured-gene denominator independently checked against nCount_RNA;no target-only normalization
patient_linkage: All23 exact sample labels matched to author Table S1 and Table S2 Patient column;one donor value within tissue;no cross-tissue pairing inferred
